stones.name: The Apprentice Stone
stones.effect: Recover Magicka faster, but take more damage from magic.
stones.location: Island in the Hjaalmarch marsh, north of Fort Snowhawk, west-northwest of Morthal

stones.name: The Atronach Stone
stones.effect: Absorb part of the spell damage that hits you and have a larger Magicka pool, but recover Magicka more slowly.
stones.location: Southern end of the Eastmarch hot springs, northwest of Mistwatch

stones.name: The Lady Stone
stones.location: Island in Lake Ilinalta, directly north of Falkreath

stones.name: The Lord Stone
stones.effect: More resistant to both magic and physical damage.
stones.location: Mountain east of Morthal, northeast of the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon

stones.name: The Lover Stone
stones.location: North of Kolskeggr Mine, on the road north from Markarth

stones.name: The Mage Stone
stones.location: Guardian Stones, by the road southwest of Riverwood

stones.name: The Ritual Stone
stones.effect: Once a day, raise nearby corpses to fight for you.
stones.location: Above the entrance to Graywinter Watch, east of Whiterun

stones.name: The Serpent Stone
stones.effect: Once a day, paralyze an opponent with a ranged poison.
stones.location: Icy island in the Sea of Ghosts, east of the College of Winterhold

stones.name: The Shadow Stone
stones.effect: Once a day, become invisible for an extended time.
stones.location: South of Riften, near Nightingale Hall

stones.name: The Steed Stone
stones.effect: Carry 100 more, and worn armor weighs nothing and doesn't slow you down.
stones.location: Near Ironback Hideout, northwest of Solitude

stones.name: The Thief Stone
stones.effect: Stealth skills and Archery improve 20% faster.
stones.location: Guardian Stones, by the road southwest of Riverwood

stones.name: The Tower Stone
stones.effect: Once a day, open any lock up to Expert difficulty.
stones.location: High cliff about halfway between Dawnstar and Winterhold

stones.name: The Warrior Stone
stones.effect: Combat skills except Archery improve 20% faster.
stones.location: Guardian Stones, by the road southwest of Riverwood
